display.purpose: Page h1 only; clamp 26-42px, weight 700, letter-spacing -0.025em, text-wrap balance.

body.purpose: Default sans body 14px / 1.55, max 75ch, text-wrap pretty.

mono.purpose: Code, command, capability key, inline API key, textarea, table of numbers.

mono-label.purpose: Uppercase + letter-spacing label, machine-style. Only legitimate use of uppercase in the system.

shadows.name: shadow-sm
shadows.purpose: Default hover lift on card / pill / tab / chip / button.

shadows.name: shadow-lg
shadows.purpose: Reserved for hero overlays (onboarding, full-bleed dialog). Currently unused.

border-stripe-allowed.purpose: Per-role chat stripe (system / tool role); muted-mix color.
Per-state status stripe (locked / ready / report / default).

components.name: Primary Button
components.css: .button.primary { background: oklch(52% 0.17 154); color: #fff; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; padding: 9px 17px; font-weight: 600; font-size: 14px; transition: background 0.15s ease, transform 0.06s ease, box-shadow 0.15s ease; } .button.primary:hover { background: oklch(42% 0.17 154); transform: translateY(-1px); } .button.primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px oklch(52% 0.17 154 / 0.10); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.css: .button.secondary { background: oklch(16% 0.015 250 / 0.08); color: oklch(16% 0.015 250); border: 0; border-radius: 999px; padding: 9px 17px; font-weight: 600; font-size: 14px; transition: background 0.15s ease; } .button.secondary:hover { background: oklch(16% 0.015 250 / 0.12); }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.css: .button.ghost { background: transparent; color: oklch(16% 0.015 250); border: 1px solid oklch(87% 0.011 235); border-radius: 999px; padding: 9px 17px; font-weight: 600; font-size: 14px; }

components.name: Danger Button
components.description: Destructive action; only for irreversible operations.
components.css: .button.danger { background: oklch(55% 0.18 25); color: #fff; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; padding: 9px 17px; font-weight: 600; font-size: 14px; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Form field; surface bg, 1px hairline, accent focus ring.
components.css: .input { background: oklch(100% 0 0); color: oklch(16% 0.015 250); border: 1px solid oklch(87% 0.011 235); border-radius: 10px; padding: 10px 12px; font: inherit; font-size: 14px; } .input:focus { outline: none; border-color: oklch(52% 0.17 154); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px oklch(52% 0.17 154 / 0.10); }

components.name: Panel
components.description: Section container; flat at rest, shadow on hover.
components.css: .panel { background: oklch(100% 0 0); color: oklch(16% 0.015 250); border: 1px solid oklch(87% 0.011 235); border-radius: 14px; padding: 28px; transition: box-shadow 0.2s ease; } .panel:hover { box-shadow: 0 1px 3px oklch(0% 0 0 / 0.06), 0 1px 2px oklch(0% 0 0 / 0.04); } .panel h2 { font-size: 18px; font-weight: 700; margin: 0 0 12px; }

components.name: Nav Button
components.description: Sidebar nav row; title + sub, full width.
components.css: .navbtn { width: 100%; text-align: left; background: transparent; color: oklch(16% 0.015 250); border: 0; border-radius: 10px; padding: 10px 12px; transition: all 0.15s ease; } .navbtn:hover { background: oklch(16% 0.015 250 / 0.05); } .navbtn.active { background: oklch(16% 0.015 250 / 0.08); box-shadow: 0 1px 3px oklch(0% 0 0 / 0.06), 0 1px 2px oklch(0% 0 0 / 0.04); } .navbtn .t { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; } .navbtn .s { font-size: 11.5px; font-weight: 400; color: oklch(49% 0.018 245); }

components.name: Capability Pill
components.css: .cap-pill { display: inline-block; background: oklch(16% 0.015 250 / 0.05); color: oklch(16% 0.015 250); font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 650; padding: 5px 10px; border-radius: 999px; transition: background 0.12s ease, border-color 0.12s ease, color 0.12s ease; } .cap-pill.active { background: oklch(52% 0.17 154 / 0.10); color: oklch(42% 0.17 154); }

components.name: Status Pill (ok / warn)
components.description: Status badge; ok uses Pass Green soft, warn uses Warn Amber soft.
components.css: .pill { display: inline-block; font-size: 12px; padding: 5px 11px; border-radius: 999px; } .pill.ok { background: oklch(55% 0.14 145 / 0.12); color: oklch(35% 0.14 145); } .pill.warn { background: oklch(68% 0.11 80 / 0.12); color: oklch(45% 0.11 80); }

components.name: Session Card
components.description: Per-CLI session summary; 5px left stripe is the per-CLI identifier exception.
components.css: .session-card { background: oklch(100% 0 0); border: 1px solid oklch(87% 0.011 235); border-left: 5px solid #183a68; border-radius: 10px; padding: 14px 16px; transition: border-color 0.15s ease, box-shadow 0.15s ease, transform 0.08s ease; } .session-card:hover { box-shadow: 0 1px 3px oklch(0% 0 0 / 0.06), 0 1px 2px oklch(0% 0 0 / 0.04); } .session-card.is-claude { border-left-color: #bd3f35; } .session-cli { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #183a68; }

narrative.overview: MMS 的 Web 配置表面是控制台，不是仪表板。它面向的是一个已经知道自己在干什么的用户——他不需要被教育、不需要被哄、不需要被一层'漂亮玻璃'挡住。设计的态度是：把诊断字段、路由参数、CLI 状态、session 摘要按密度平铺出来，绿色高亮像示波器上的脉冲，告诉用户'这里是活的'，其他地方安静地退到冷灰里。失败也要讲清楚哪个字段、什么值、为什么非法。
keyCharacteristics: Cool neutrals only; accent is OKLCH 52% 0.17 154 (cool green), not emerald, not warm
Shadow is state-only: flat at rest, raised only on hover/active/focus/pending
Backdrop-blur limited to header / sidebar / pending bar; cards never
Color is never the only signal: status always pairs with mono kicker text or position
Three font families ceiling: sans body + mono labels + display (sans + weight)
All panel-level numbers use font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums
Uppercase + letter-spacing only on mono machine labels; never on body or titles

rules.name: The Cool-Only Rule
rules.body: All custom hues must fall within hue 140-250. The single exception is --warn (hue 80). No warm cream / sand / paper / parchment / bone / linen / wheat / biscuit / ivory / flour.

rules.name: The One-Aid Rule
rules.body: Primary brand accent (Signal Green) is used on <=15% of any visible surface. Rarity is the point.

rules.name: The Double-Signal Rule
rules.body: Any ok / warn / danger state must pair color with mono kicker text (e.g. 'WARN: stale config') or position marker. Color is never the only signal.

rules.name: The Uppercase-Mono Rule
rules.body: uppercase + letter-spacing only on mono font labels. Body, headlines, card titles forbid uppercase.

rules.name: The Three-Family Ceiling
rules.body: Never exceed three font families. Display = body + weight. Never introduce a serif or humanist secondary.

rules.name: The Tabular-Numbers Rule
rules.body: Any panel-level number must use font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums.

rules.name: The Flat-At-Rest Rule
rules.body: Resting surfaces have zero shadow. Use 1px hairline border + 0.005-0.015 chroma surface tint, not shadow, for depth.

rules.name: The State-Only-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Shadows serve interaction states only (hover, active, focus, modal lift). Never use shadow for ambient depth on resting cards.

dos: Do use OKLCH throughout; no HSL / RGB-as-design-token / scattered #hex (except the four documented per-CLI and per-role hex escape tokens).
Do pair color with mono kicker text. 'WARN: stale config' beats a lone amber dot.
Do use font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums on any panel-level number.
Do use text-wrap: balance on h1-h3 and text-wrap: pretty on long prose.
Do keep body line length <=75ch and body padding above 16px.
Do keep h1 to one per page; if you need a second hero, you've already failed.
Do use 1px hairline borders for separation, not 2-3px colored stripes on neutral cards.
Do use --shadow-sm and --shadow for hover/active state response, not for ambient depth.
Do cap body font-size at 14px and section title at 18px. Display max 56px (only in .settings-command semantic block).
Do expose route / provider / protocol / cache in the default state, not behind a 'Show details' toggle.
donts: Don't use border-left or border-right greater than 1px as a colored accent on neutral cards, list items, callouts, or alerts. Two known exceptions (.session-card 5px, .session-message 4px) are per-CLI / per-role semantic stripes and stay; new violations are a hard fail.
Don't use background-clip: text + gradient background for emphasis. Use single solid color or weight.
Don't use backdrop-filter: blur decoratively on cards. Three known exceptions (header, .side, .asset-pending-inner) stay; new uses on cards / panels are a hard fail.
Don't use uppercase + letter-spacing on body text, headlines, or card titles. The mono-kicker uppercase pattern is the only allowed location.
Don't add '01 / 02 / 03' numbered section markers as a reflex. Use them only when the section is genuinely a sequence.
Don't add a SaaS-style eyebrow (ABOUT / PROCESS / PRICING all-caps, wide tracking) above every section. .settings-kicker is mono-machine, not decorative eyebrow.
Don't ship animations without a prefers-reduced-motion: reduce fallback. Current code is missing this (P1 audit item).
Don't ship interactive elements without :focus-visible styles. Currently only inputs have :focus rules; buttons / navbtns / chips / tabs are missing (P1 audit item).
Don't use box-shadow for ambient depth on resting cards. Use border + bg tint.
Don't use warm cream / sand / paper / parchment / bone / linen / wheat / biscuit / ivory / flour background hues.

Don't use the marketing-buzzword family: streamline / empower / supercharge / leverage / unleash / seamless / world-class / enterprise-grade / next-generation / cutting-edge / game-changer / mission-critical.
Don't use em dashes (—) or -- in body copy. Use commas, colons, semicolons, periods, or parentheses.
Don't use the 'big number, small label, gradient accent' hero-metric template.
Don't repeat the section title in the section body.
Don't default to dark mode; the cool-light baseline is the spec.
